title: High Security Number Plate HSRP Online Registration 2021
organization: Ministry of Road Transport / State Transport / Authorised Vendors
selectionProcess: Online registration / application as per portal process
documentsRequired: Aadhaar, photo ID, mobile number, email, supporting certificates as required
howToApply:
1. Visit state transport / authorised HSRP booking portal or Vahan-related link
2. Enter vehicle registration number
3. Select fitment centre
4. Pay fee online
5. Visit centre with RC for fitment
shortDescription: HSRP High Security Number Plate Online Registration – book fitment for vehicles via authorised state portals.
content:
High Security Registration Plates (HSRP) are mandatory for vehicles as per MoRTH directions.

Vehicle owners book online through state-authorised portals, pay fees, and get laser-branded plates fitted at approved centres along with colour-coded stickers. Keep Registration Certificate (RC) ready.
